caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a two-part structure. The top section features two glass-paneled doors with a geometric pattern formed by brown and yellow framing, through which a blue and off-white background is visible. The lower section consists of drawers: the first row includes four smaller drawers with decorated circular and oval motifs in reddish-brown hues, accented with a small round knob in the center of each drawer front; below, there are three wider drawers, each with two round drawer pulls spaced apart horizontally, all in a matching brownish tone. The wood is illustrated in shades of brown with visible grain, giving the impression of a stained finish. At the top of the image, above the colored drawing, is a line drawing in blue ink showing the side elevation and frontal view of another piece of furniture, likely a sideboard, with multiple drawers and ornamental cutouts along the bottom. The sheet background is a plain off-white color.
title: Desk
